news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 2 experienced directors. 2 highly experienced directors. 1 independent director (3 non-independent directors). Non-Executive Independent Director Saroj Rathod was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.
